data.narrative:
Theseus is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by a technical team with backgrounds in mechanical engineering, software development, and AI research. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of ten comparable companies—two public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private, including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—all operating in adjacent subsectors at Seed through Series A stages.

Two valuation methodologies were applied. Stage-Progression anchors to Theseus's $4.3M total raised and applies a standard 2.5x multiplier for advancement from Seed to next stage, yielding $11M. The Peer-Median method examines five directly comparable companies in Defense & Security at the same or adjacent stages, spanning valuations from $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A), with a median of $1.0B. This 32x spread reflects the sector's wide dispersion in funding and growth trajectories.

The triangulated analysis yields a low of $9M, a median of $505M, and a high of $1.1B. The substantial gap between stage-based and peer-derived estimates reflects Theseus's nascent revenue profile relative to later-stage peers with operational scale. Key uncertainties include product differentiation within an increasingly crowded defense-tech landscape, customer acquisition pathway (government procurement complexity), and technical validation of core capabilities. A valuation in the $10M–$50M range better reflects comparable Seed-stage entries before customer traction and technical proof points are established.
